purpose: Ground truth on a REAL application. Every judge accuracy figure in this project so far comes from a 5-page fixture whose bugs were authored alongside the judge; on Gitea there was no ground truth at all, so precision rested on a human reading a handful of verdicts. These six defects are injected through Gitea's own supported customization path ($GITEA_CUSTOM/templates) rather than a fork, so stock behaviour is restored by deleting a directory and the application under test is otherwise genuinely unmodified.

detectability_legend.deterministic: a console-error / HTTP-error / stuck-page trigger fires; reachable without a language model
detectability_legend.llm_required: every page returns 200, logs nothing and settles; only semantic judgment can find it
detectability_legend.cross_step: evidence spans more than one transition, so a single before/after pair cannot contain it
detectability_legend.viewport: only observable at a non-default viewport width

bugs.title: The Explore 'Organizations' tab opens the user listing
bugs.repro: From /explore/repos, click the 'Organizations' tab in the explore navbar.
bugs.actual: Navigates to /explore/users and lists user accounts. The tab label and its destination disagree.
bugs.note: Seeded on the Organizations tab rather than Users deliberately: breaking the Users tab would make /explore/users unreachable by following links, and GITEA-05 lives there. A seeded bug no explorer can reach is a permanent miss dressed up as a judge failure.

bugs.title: 'Export results' does nothing
bugs.repro: On any explore page, click the 'Export results' button in the navbar.
bugs.expected: Produce an export, or at minimum issue a request or show feedback.
bugs.actual: No navigation, no network request, no DOM change. The control has no handler at all.

bugs.title: Registration and sign-in become unreachable on a narrow viewport
bugs.repro: Resize the viewport to 375px on any page.
bugs.expected: Sign In and Register stay reachable, directly or via a menu control.
bugs.actual: Both navbar links and the mobile menu toggle are hidden with nothing replacing them, so no route to an account remains at that width.

bugs.title: The repository search box is cleared after searching
bugs.repro: On /explore/repos, type a keyword into the search box and submit.
bugs.expected: The results are filtered and the search box still shows the keyword that produced them.
bugs.actual: The results are filtered correctly but the box is emptied, so the page no longer states what it is showing and refining the query means retyping it.

bugs.title: Uncaught TypeError on the user listing
bugs.repro: Open /explore/users and wait for scripts to run.
bugs.expected: The page renders without console errors.
bugs.actual: Throws "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'render')" about 120ms after load.

bugs.title: A repository home page never stops mutating
bugs.repro: Open any repository home page, e.g. /tester/notes.
bugs.expected: The DOM settles shortly after load.
bugs.actual: A timer rewrites an element every 100ms forever, so DOM quiescence is never reached — the same signal as a spinner that never resolves.

false_positive_watch: Anonymous users are redirected to /user/login when they activate any write control (New Issue, New Repository, Fork, Star). That is correct behaviour, not a broken link.
Repository sub-tabs with empty collections (forks, stars, watchers, packages) render an empty list or an empty-state sentence. An empty list is a correct answer.
Footer links to docs.gitea.com, github.com and about.gitea.com leave the application; the harness refuses or discards them and the link itself is fine.
The footer language selector reloads the current page under a different locale, which correctly changes most visible text.
/api/swagger is a vendored third-party console; its own widget behaviour is not Gitea application behaviour.
Star/fork/watch counters reading 0 are correct for a repository nobody has starred.
notes: Deterministic ceiling is 2/6 (GITEA-05, GITEA-06). That is the number the LLM judge has to beat on a real application, and it is the direct analogue of the toy site's 3/10.

Four of the six are llm_required by construction: every page involved returns HTTP 200, logs nothing to the console and settles normally, so no trigger in reward/functional_triggers.py can fire on them.

GITEA-03 requires a RESIZE_VIEWPORT action and GITEA-04 requires TYPE then submit then observe, so recall on this key also measures whether the explorer reaches the states at all — report exploration coverage alongside judge recall rather than conflating them.

GITEA-01 is deliberately close to a false positive: the destination is a real, working page, so the only thing wrong is that it disagrees with the label. A judge that only checks 'did the click go somewhere' will miss it.
